scope: offline simulation and deterministic replay only; no OTA and no Sources integration
hypothesis: At the accepted Cyrinx 2 occupied band, payload schedule, coding rate, and equal digital peak, localized DFT-spread OFDM reduces the held-out 99.9th-percentile payload crest factor by at least 3 dB relative to conventional OFDM without regressing the coded room-response probe or the frozen digital spectral mask.

incumbent.mapping: 64-QAM data directly occupies every non-pilot used FFT bin; known QPSK pilots occupy physical used-bin positions 0,16,...,928
incumbent.receiver: two conventional full-band sync symbols estimate the per-bin channel; each payload symbol uses its physical comb pilots for one common complex correction before 64-QAM demapping

candidate.name_constraint: localized DFT-spread OFDM; never label this candidate SC-FDE
candidate.mapping: form a 935-element logical vector in ascending allocation order, with QPSK pilots at logical positions 0,16,...,928 and the identical 64-QAM values at all other positions; apply numpy.fft.fft(vector,norm='ortho'); map its 935 outputs without permutation to contiguous physical FFT bins 47...981; Hermitian real IFFT remains 2048 points
candidate.receiver: estimate and one-tap-equalize physical bins with the same two conventional sync symbols; apply numpy.fft.ifft(equalized,norm='ortho'); use recovered logical pilots for one common complex correction; demap the remaining logical positions
forbidden_changes: no interleaved or distributed FDMA mapping
no pilot redesign or timing-slope estimator added after results
no candidate-specific coding, CP, training, band, payload schedule, or data-bit selection

pilots_and_training.sync_values: existing modem.sync_symbol_freq for which=0 and which=1
pilots_and_training.sync_waveform: conventional OFDM for both arms, scaled once to digital peak 0.18 and therefore sample-identical between arms
pilots_and_training.pilot_accounting: 59 known QPSK values consume the same 59 of 935 logical/physical allocation slots in every payload symbol in both arms
pilots_and_training.timing_and_clock_model: known symbol boundaries, no CFO, no SRO, and no timing drift; the frozen receiver estimates only a common complex residual per payload symbol
pilots_and_training.preamble_accounting: the chirp and 2048-sample guard are included in schedule arithmetic but omitted from channel simulation because acquisition is not the hypothesis

normalization.payload_limiter: apply a symmetric hard limit at 3.3 times each arm's own pre-limit payload RMS over all 64 symbols, then independently normalize each limited payload body to peak 0.18
normalization.crest_factor_primary: 20*log10(max(abs(x))/rms(x)) on the complete 64-symbol payload body including CP, before the 3.3-sigma limiter
normalization.whole_body_diagnostic: also report sync-plus-payload and post-limiter crest factors
normalization.mean_power: report signed mean, RMS, and mean-square value after equal-peak payload normalization
normalization.matched_rms: not a deciding cell and not run OTA; derivable only as a labeled diagnostic

coded_probe.scope_limit: one independently CRC-protected 256-byte probe is spread across each otherwise full accepted-schedule frame; this is not a claim of decoding all 107 production blocks
coded_probe.payload: 256 deterministic random bytes followed by existing big-endian CRC32
coded_probe.encoder: existing K=7 (171,133) convolutional code, six zero tail bits, then existing rate-2/3 puncture pattern [1,1,0,1]
coded_probe.placement: punctured bit j occupies flattened symbol-major/data-slot-major/MSB-first position (offset + j*65537) mod 336384; gcd(65537,336384)=1; offset is the frame seed mod 336384; all other positions contain deterministic random bits
coded_probe.demapper: max-log 64-QAM LLRs with variance estimated from that arm's known pilots and sync residuals only
coded_probe.decoder: soft Viterbi, forced terminal state zero, followed by CRC32
coded_probe.interpretation: CRC recovery is a paired coded probe of the waveform/channel, not production frame-wide goodput

randomization.frame_seed_derivation: first 8 bytes, big-endian, of SHA256('cyrinx-spike-8c-v1\0' + decimal master seed + '\0' + cell id + '\0' + decimal local frame index)
randomization.paired_inputs: candidate and incumbent receive identical logical pilots, data labels, CRC-probe bits, and additive-noise samples
randomization.frame_order: cells execute in the listed order; local frame indices execute 0...999; arm calculations are incumbent then candidate but no adaptive decisions are permitted

cells.provenance: Tests/Fixtures/golden deterministic RX_CHANNEL_TAPS; model fixture, not a measured RIR

sample_count_and_split.retained_capture_availability: no raw retained room PCM or measured RIR is tracked in this worktree; only the explicitly identified deterministic/modelled tap fixtures are admissible

noise.definition: for each paired frame, channel both equal-peak arms first; set Gaussian noise RMS from the incumbent payload receive RMS and the cell SNR; add the exact same sample-valued noise vector to both arms
noise.reason: preserves the fixed-peak hypothesis instead of silently granting each arm equal received RMS

spectral_measurement.input: post-limiter, equal-peak first payload symbol including CP from every held-out frame
spectral_measurement.estimator: accumulate squared magnitude of an 8192-point real FFT with a rectangular observation and normalize by total spectral energy
spectral_measurement.out_of_band: absolute frequencies below 1100 Hz or above 23000 Hz
spectral_measurement.guard_peak: maximum normalized bin power below 1000 Hz or above 23100 Hz
spectral_measurement.non_regression: candidate out-of-band/in-band energy ratio may not exceed incumbent by more than 0.25 dB and candidate guard-peak level may not exceed incumbent by more than 1.0 dB

metrics.primary: held-out 99.9th-percentile pre-limiter payload crest-factor reduction in dB, incumbent minus candidate
reported: signed mean, RMS, and mean-square power at fixed peak
coded-probe CRC recovery overall and by cell
payload EVM RMS median, p90, and p99 overall and by cell
hard coded-bit error rate before Viterbi
out-of-band/in-band energy and guard-peak spectral levels
Python prototype generation/receive wall time and candidate/incumbent ratio

decision.coded_rir_gate: on all held-out non-identity cells, the lower endpoint of a deterministic 20000-replicate cell-stratified paired bootstrap 95% interval for candidate-minus-incumbent CRC recovery is >= -0.005, and no individual RIR/SNR cell point difference is below -0.02
decision.spectral_gate: both frozen spectral non-regression limits pass
decision.integrity_gate: all deterministic unit/invariant tests pass, exactly 10000 frames finish, and no non-finite deciding metric occurs
decision.proceed_ota: permitted only if all four gates pass; permission means only that a separately preregistered bounded OTA screen may be designed, not that OTA ran or library integration is justified
decision.stop: if any gate fails, do not run OTA, redesign pilots, change mapping, or integrate; publish the failure and name the minimum next executable experiment

artifacts: this preregistration JSON and its SHA256
cell-level CSV without per-frame payload bytes
scientific report with exact command, code hash, runtime, limitations, and decision
known_unmeasured_limits: no speaker, microphone, OS dynamics/protection, clipping, THD, intermodulation, or acoustic SPL is modelled or measured
no measured retained room impulse response is available in the tracked checkout
known timing, no CFO/SRO, and oracle symbol boundaries make this less demanding than OTA acquisition/tracking
the one-block coded probe is not production frame-wide throughput
the Python compute ratio does not predict optimized C or mobile real-time cost
